  • Constructor Details

    • ConsistencyCheck

      public ConsistencyCheck(KB kb, String fileName, String userSessionId, String proverType, String tptpLanguage, String vampireMode, boolean closedWorldAssumption, boolean modusPonens, boolean dropOnePremise, boolean holUseModals, int timeout, int maxAnswers, ConsistencyCheckManager.ConsistencyCheckMode checkMode)
      Creates a consistency check using TheoremProverController.runQuery().
      Parameters:
      kb - KB to check
      fileName - output XML file
      userSessionId - source user session id
      proverType - prover selected by the UI
      tptpLanguage - TPTP-family language: FOF, TFF, or THF
      vampireMode - Vampire execution mode
      closedWorldAssumption - whether to use CWA
      modusPonens - whether to use modus ponens
      dropOnePremise - whether to drop one-premise formulas
      holUseModals - whether to use modal HOL translation
      timeout - timeout in seconds
      maxAnswers - maximum answers
      checkMode - consistency-check mode
